roe.name: ROE (Return on Equity)
roe.description: Measures profitability relative to shareholders' equity. Higher means management is using investor capital more efficiently to generate profit.

roa.name: ROA (Return on Assets)
roa.description: Average Total Assets is (Beginning + Ending Total Assets) / 2. Higher means management is using resources more efficiently to generate earnings.

debt_to_equity.name: Debt-to-Equity Ratio
debt_to_equity.description: Measures leverage - how much a company finances its operations with debt versus its own funds. A lower ratio generally indicates greater financial stability.

current_ratio.name: Current Ratio
current_ratio.formula: Total Current Assets / Total Current Liabilities
current_ratio.description: Measures ability to pay short-term obligations (due within one year) with current assets. Above 1.0 is healthy; 1.5-2.0 is generally considered ideal.

quick_ratio.name: Quick Ratio (Acid-Test Ratio)
quick_ratio.description: Measures ability to pay short-term liabilities with the most liquid assets, excluding inventory. A ratio of 1:1 is considered ideal.

operating_profit_margin.name: Operating Profit Margin
operating_profit_margin.description: Measures core operational efficiency - the percentage of revenue remaining after covering cost of goods sold and operating expenses, before interest and taxes. Higher indicates better profitability.

interest_coverage_ratio.name: Interest Coverage Ratio
interest_coverage_ratio.description: Measures ability to pay interest on outstanding debt (uses Operating Income as a proxy for EBIT). Above 2-3 is typically considered good; higher means lower default risk.

ebitda_margin.name: EBITDA Margin
ebitda_margin.formula: (Net Income + Interest Expense + Income Tax Expense + Depreciation & Amortization) / Revenue
ebitda_margin.description: Measures operational profitability excluding financing, tax, and non-cash expenses. Higher indicates the business converts more of its core operations into earnings.

eps.name: Basic EPS
eps.formula: Reported directly on the Income Statement
eps.description: Net income divided by weighted-average shares outstanding, as calculated and disclosed by the company itself.

diluted_eps.name: Diluted EPS
diluted_eps.formula: Reported directly on the Income Statement
diluted_eps.description: Like Basic EPS, but assumes all convertible securities (options, warrants, convertible debt) are exercised - a conservative, usually lower, per-share figure.

shareholder_equity.name: Shareholder Equity
shareholder_equity.description: A company's net worth - the residual value belonging to owners after all liabilities are settled. Reported directly on the Balance Sheet.

cash_on_hand.name: Cash on Hand
cash_on_hand.formula: Reported directly on the Balance Sheet
cash_on_hand.description: Total immediately accessible cash and cash equivalents.

dividend_per_share.name: Dividend Per Share
dividend_per_share.formula: Reported directly on the financial statements
dividend_per_share.description: The portion of profit paid to shareholders per share owned. 0 if the company does not pay a dividend.

pe_ratio.name: Price-to-Earnings (P/E) Ratio
pe_ratio.description: Measures how much investors pay per $1 of earnings. A high ratio may suggest overvaluation or high growth expectations.

pb_ratio.name: Price-to-Book (P/B) Ratio
pb_ratio.formula: Share Price / Book Value Per Share
pb_ratio.description: Measures market valuation relative to net asset (book) value. A lower P/B (often < 1) may indicate an undervalued stock.

peg_ratio.name: Price/Earnings-to-Growth (PEG) Ratio
peg_ratio.formula: P/E Ratio / Expected Earnings Growth Rate (%)
peg_ratio.description: Divides P/E by expected earnings growth to judge value relative to growth prospects. ~1.0 suggests fair value.

dividend_yield.name: Dividend Yield
dividend_yield.formula: Annual Dividend Per Share / Share Price
dividend_yield.description: Annualized cash dividends as a percentage of the share price.

roi.name: ROI (Return on Investment)
roi.description: Evaluates profitability and efficiency of a specific investment by comparing its gain to its initial cost. Only computable when the report explicitly discusses a specific investment in these terms.

debt_service_ratio.name: Debt Service Ratio
debt_service_ratio.formula: Operating Cash Flow / (Principal + Interest Payments Due)
debt_service_ratio.description: Measures ability to cover debt obligations (principal + interest) with operating cash flow. Above 1.0 is sufficient; 1.25+ is standard for lenders.

debt_service_coverage_ratio.name: Debt Service Coverage Ratio
debt_service_coverage_ratio.description: Measures ability to cover debt obligations with EBITDA. 1.0 is break-even; lenders typically require 1.25+.

extraction_meta.prompt:
You are extracting facts from a company's annual report for its MOST RECENT fiscal year. You have TWO jobs below. Do no arithmetic yourself either way - only report numbers literally printed in the document, never from outside knowledge.

Some of the fields and ratios below are retail-domain KPIs - they only apply if this company's business matches that domain. If they don't apply, leave them null; don't force a fit.

Rules that apply throughout:
- Every field is optional. Use value: 0 ONLY when the document EXPLICITLY states a fact equivalent to zero/none (e.g. "we have not declared any cash dividends", "amounts outstanding were zero") - quote that exact statement in source_quote. If the document simply never discusses a topic at all (no mention of it anywhere), that is NOT the same as zero - use null instead. Do not guess 0 just because you found nothing; 0 must be something the document actually says, not your absence-of-evidence.
- Match by meaning, not exact wording - filers phrase the same concept differently (e.g. "Shareholders' equity" = "Total stockholders' equity"; "ROE" = "return on equity").
- When the same figure appears at different precision in different places, use the exact one from the primary financial statement, not a rounded mention elsewhere.
- If a line item is split into sub-components shown separately, report their sum and show each component plus the total in source_quote.

JOB 1 - Raw input values. Find these in the CONSOLIDATED financial statements:

- net_income: Consolidated Statements of Operations/Income, most recent fiscal year
- total_stockholders_equity: Consolidated Balance Sheet, most recent fiscal year end
- beginning_total_assets: Total Assets, Consolidated Balance Sheet, PRIOR fiscal year end
- ending_total_assets: Total Assets, Consolidated Balance Sheet, most recent fiscal year end
- total_liabilities: Total Liabilities, Consolidated Balance Sheet, most recent fiscal year end
- total_current_assets: Total Current Assets, Consolidated Balance Sheet
- total_current_liabilities: Total Current Liabilities, Consolidated Balance Sheet
- inventory: Inventory, Consolidated Balance Sheet
- cash_and_equivalents: Cash and Cash Equivalents, Consolidated Balance Sheet
- revenue: Total Revenue / Net Sales, Consolidated Statements of Operations
- operating_income: Operating Income / Income from Operations, Consolidated Statements of Operations
- interest_expense: Interest Expense, Consolidated Statements of Operations
- income_tax_expense: Income Tax Expense / Provision for Income Taxes, Consolidated Statements of Operations
- depreciation_and_amortization: Depreciation and Amortization, Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows
- basic_eps: Basic Earnings Per Share, Consolidated Statements of Operations
- diluted_eps: Diluted Earnings Per Share, Consolidated Statements of Operations
- dividend_per_share: Dividends declared/paid per share
- operating_cash_flow: Net Cash Provided by Operating Activities, Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows
- shares_outstanding: Shares of common stock outstanding
- share_price: The company's own stock price, if stated anywhere in this document
- expected_growth_rate: A forward-looking earnings growth rate estimate, if the company states one
- investment_cost: Cost of a specific named investment, if the report discusses one
- investment_gain: Gain on that same named investment, if discussed alongside its cost
- debt_principal_and_interest_due: Principal + interest due in the coming year on borrowed-money debt (loans, bonds, credit facility draws)
- sss_net_sales_current: Same-store (comparable) net sales across all channels, current fiscal year
- sss_net_sales_prior: Same-store (comparable) net sales across all channels, prior fiscal year - same store base as above
- retail_store_sss_net_sales_current: Same-store net sales from physical retail stores only, current fiscal year
- retail_store_sss_net_sales_prior: Same-store net sales from physical retail stores only, prior fiscal year
- ecommerce_sss_net_sales_current: Same-store (comparable) net sales from the e-commerce/direct-to-consumer channel, current fiscal year
- ecommerce_sss_net_sales_prior: Same-store (comparable) net sales from the e-commerce/direct-to-consumer channel, prior fiscal year
- exclusive_brand_net_sales: Net sales from the retailer's own exclusive/proprietary brands
- third_party_brand_net_sales: Net sales from third-party/national brands carried by the retailer
- beginning_store_count: Number of stores open at the start of the fiscal year
- ending_store_count: Number of stores open at the end of the fiscal year
- retail_store_net_sales: Net sales from physical retail stores (all stores, not just comparable), most recent fiscal year
- capex_per_new_store: Average capital expenditure to open one new store, net of landlord/tenant allowances
- store_contribution_margin: Annual store-level contribution margin for a mature/average store (e.g. EBITDAR minus rent), if disclosed
- cost_of_goods_sold: Cost of Goods Sold / Cost of Merchandise Sold, Consolidated Statements of Operations
- store_occupancy_costs: Store occupancy costs (rent, utilities, property taxes, common area maintenance) included within cost of goods sold
- distribution_freight_costs: Distribution center and freight/fulfillment costs included within cost of goods sold

For each raw value, report:
- value: the exact number in whole dollars (not thousands - if the statement says "in thousands", multiply by 1000). Per-share fields (EPS, dividend per share, share price) are already per-share, do not scale them.
- as_printed: an exact substring a text search would find on the page, used to jump straight to this value in the source document. If the number is printed as a digit, use it exactly as printed (e.g. "180,942"), BEFORE any unit scaling. If instead the value is INFERRED from a qualitative statement with no digit printed at all (e.g. "we have not declared any cash dividends" implying $0), as_printed must be a short distinctive phrase copied verbatim from source_quote instead - never a number that does not actually appear on the page.
- unit_note: the exact nearby text establishing scale, e.g. "in thousands", "in millions", or "whole dollars" if no scaling note is nearby - quote it verbatim, do not paraphrase.
- source_page: the PDF page number (1-indexed, count actual PDF pages) where you found it.
- source_quote: the exact line of text containing this number, quoted verbatim.

consolidated_sss_growth.name: Consolidated Same-Store Sales Growth
consolidated_sss_growth.formula: (Same-Store Net Sales, Current Year - Same-Store Net Sales, Prior Year) / Same-Store Net Sales, Prior Year
consolidated_sss_growth.description: Retail KPI. Net sales growth from stores open long enough (typically 14+ months) to exclude the effect of new store openings.
consolidated_sss_growth.source_note: Stated directly - p. 51: "Same Store Sales growth/(decline) 5.5 % (6.2)% (0.1)%"

retail_store_sss.name: Retail Store Same-Store Sales Growth
retail_store_sss.formula: (Store SSS Net Sales, Current Period - Store SSS Net Sales, Prior Period) / Store SSS Net Sales, Prior Period
retail_store_sss.description: Retail KPI. Same-store sales growth isolated to the physical retail store channel.

ecommerce_sss.name: E-commerce Same-Store Sales Growth
ecommerce_sss.formula: (E-commerce Net Sales, Current Period - E-commerce Net Sales, Prior Period) / E-commerce Net Sales, Prior Period
ecommerce_sss.description: Retail KPI. Same-store sales growth isolated to the e-commerce/direct- to-consumer channel.

exclusive_brand_penetration.name: Exclusive Brand Penetration
exclusive_brand_penetration.formula: Net Sales from Exclusive Brands / Total Net Sales
exclusive_brand_penetration.description: Retail KPI. Share of revenue from a retailer's own higher-margin proprietary brands versus third-party/national brands.
exclusive_brand_penetration.source_note: Stated directly - p. 16: "In fiscal 2025, sales from our exclusive brand products accounted for approximately 38.6% of our consolidated sales."

third_party_brand_penetration.name: Third-Party Brand Penetration
third_party_brand_penetration.formula: Net Sales from Third-Party Brands / Total Net Sales
third_party_brand_penetration.description: Retail KPI. Share of revenue from third-party/national brands versus a retailer's own exclusive brands.

average_net_revenue_per_store.name: Average Net Revenue Per Store
average_net_revenue_per_store.formula: Retail Store Net Sales / Average Store Count
average_net_revenue_per_store.description: Retail KPI. Average Store Count is (Beginning + Ending Store Count) / 2. Measures individual store productivity.

capex_payback_period.name: CapEx Payback Period (Years)
capex_payback_period.formula: Initial Capital Expenditure Per New Store / Annual Store-Level Contribution Margin
capex_payback_period.description: Retail KPI. Years needed for a new store's investment to be recovered from its own contribution margin (e.g. EBITDAR minus rent). Shorter is better.
capex_payback_period.source_note: Stated directly - p. 10: "Our new store model requires an average net cash investment of approximately $1.7 million and targets an average payback period of three years."

merchandise_margin_rate.name: Merchandise Margin Rate
merchandise_margin_rate.formula: (Net Sales - (Cost of Goods Sold - Occupancy and Distribution Costs)) / Net Sales
merchandise_margin_rate.description: Retail KPI. Margin on product sales alone, excluding the store occupancy and distribution/fulfillment costs bundled into Cost of Goods Sold.

occupancy_cost_rate.name: Occupancy Cost Rate
occupancy_cost_rate.formula: (Store Occupancy Costs + Distribution & Freight/Fulfillment Costs) / Net Sales
occupancy_cost_rate.description: Retail KPI. Operating leverage on fixed retail and distribution infrastructure, as a percentage of net sales.

gross_margin_rate.name: Gross Margin Rate
gross_margin_rate.formula: (Net Sales - Cost of Goods Sold) / Net Sales
gross_margin_rate.description: Retail KPI. GAAP gross profit margin after product and store/warehouse occupancy overhead - equals Merchandise Margin Rate minus Occupancy Cost Rate.

roe.name: ROE (Return on Equity)
roe.description: Measures profitability relative to shareholders' equity. Higher means management is using investor capital more efficiently to generate profit.

roa.name: ROA (Return on Assets)
roa.description: Average Total Assets is (Beginning + Ending Total Assets) / 2. Higher means management is using resources more efficiently to generate earnings.

debt_to_equity.name: Debt-to-Equity Ratio
debt_to_equity.description: Measures leverage - how much a company finances its operations with debt versus its own funds. A lower ratio generally indicates greater financial stability.

current_ratio.name: Current Ratio
current_ratio.formula: Total Current Assets / Total Current Liabilities
current_ratio.description: Measures ability to pay short-term obligations (due within one year) with current assets. Above 1.0 is healthy; 1.5-2.0 is generally considered ideal.

quick_ratio.name: Quick Ratio (Acid-Test Ratio)
quick_ratio.description: Measures ability to pay short-term liabilities with the most liquid assets, excluding inventory. A ratio of 1:1 is considered ideal.

operating_profit_margin.name: Operating Profit Margin

interest_coverage_ratio.name: Interest Coverage Ratio
